library.unifiedIntro.source: 统一查找布局、坐标评价、编辑副本和信号实验。每条记录保留自己的评价协议与原布局关联。
library.unifiedIntro.en: Find layouts, coordinate evaluations, edited copies and signal experiments together. Each record retains its evaluation protocol and original-layout association.

library.scope.source: 信号实验仅收录当前浏览器的已完成任务；服务器保留最近1000个计算回执，打开已有结果生成的回执另保留300个。筛选记录不会读取完整波形或启动计算。
library.scope.en: Signal experiments include completed tasks from this browser. The server keeps the latest 1000 computation receipts and, separately, 300 receipts created by opening an existing result. Filtering neither loads full waveforms nor starts computation.

library.related.source: 同一原布局的关联记录
library.related.en: Records associated with this original layout

library.relatedIntro.source: 编辑副本与信号实验分别关联原布局；信号实验使用其记录指定的完整布局。
library.relatedIntro.en: Edited copies and signal experiments each refer to their original layout. Signal experiments use the complete layout specified in their record.

library.editorFetchError.source: 电极编辑记录未载入，请刷新记录。
library.editorFetchError.en: Electrode editing records could not be loaded. Refresh the records.

library.sourceFetchError.source: 当前浏览器的信号记录未载入，请刷新记录。
library.sourceFetchError.en: Signal records from this browser could not be loaded. Refresh the records.

library.editorDetails.source: 编辑评分使用独立协议。载入后恢复这条记录的点位；重新评价时检查模型、原布局与缓存。
library.editorDetails.en: Editing scores use a separate protocol. Loading restores this record's electrode positions; re-evaluation checks the model, original layout and cache.

library.sourceDetails.source: 打开后恢复源模式、源位置、波形、干扰幅度与随机种子，并检查该场景的已有缓存。
library.sourceDetails.en: Opening restores source mode and positions, waveform, artifact amplitude and random seed, and checks the saved cache for this scenario.

library.legacyDetails.source: 历史信号协议保留原结果下载；当前信号页面使用不同源分区，不能直接恢复这个场景。
library.legacyDetails.en: Historical signal results remain available for download. The current signal workspace uses different source regions and cannot directly restore this scenario.

library.missingSummary.source: 这条旧任务未保存指标摘要，查看或下载结果时读取完整记录。
library.missingSummary.en: This older task has no saved metric summary. Viewing or downloading loads the complete record.

library.invalidEditorKey.source: 编辑记录编号无效，请从记录列表重新选择。
library.invalidEditorKey.en: The edited record ID is invalid. Select it again from the records.

library.missingEditor.source: 指定编辑记录无法读取，或与原布局不一致。
library.missingEditor.en: The specified edited record is unavailable or does not match the original layout.

library.visibility.othersPublic.source: 共享库 · 其他访客公开
library.visibility.othersPublic.en: Shared library · published by another visitor

library.visibility.pending.source: 已申请公开 · 等待审核

library.visibility.removed.source: 已被管理员从共享库移除
library.visibility.removed.en: Removed from the shared library by the operator

library.visibility.confirm.source: 公开后，所有访客都能在共享库看到这条记录：名称「{{0}}」、电极坐标、计算参数和指标。可随时撤回公开。确认公开？
library.visibility.confirm.en: Once published, every visitor can see this record in the shared library: the name “{{0}}”, the electrode coordinates, the computation settings and the metrics. You can withdraw it at any time. Publish?

library.visibility.privateNote.source: 只有提交过这条记录的浏览器能在列表中看到它；持有记录链接的人仍可打开。
library.visibility.privateNote.en: Only browsers that submitted this record see it in their lists; anyone holding the record link can still open it.

library.visibility.pendingNote.source: 管理员审核通过后，其他访客才能在共享库看到它。
library.visibility.pendingNote.en: Other visitors see it in the shared library after the operator approves it.

library.visibility.otherOwner.source: 提交过同一配置的另一个浏览器已公开这条记录。
library.visibility.otherOwner.en: Another browser that submitted the same configuration has published this record.

library.visibility.scopeReview.source: 本浏览器提交的计算默认只有本浏览器能在列表中看到。公开到共享库的记录经管理员审核后对所有访客列出；官方实验记录始终列出。清除浏览器数据后列表将找不到自己的记录，需要长期保留请加入研究项目。
library.visibility.scopeReview.en: Computations submitted from this browser are listed only to this browser by default. Records published to the shared library are listed to every visitor after the operator reviews them; official experiment records are always listed. After clearing browser data you will no longer find your records in the list; add them to a research project to keep them.

library.visibility.scope.source: 本浏览器提交的计算默认只有本浏览器能在列表中看到。公开到共享库的记录对所有访客列出；官方实验记录始终列出。清除浏览器数据后列表将找不到自己的记录，需要长期保留请加入研究项目。
library.visibility.scope.en: Computations submitted from this browser are listed only to this browser by default. Records published to the shared library are listed to every visitor; official experiment records are always listed. After clearing browser data you will no longer find your records in the list; add them to a research project to keep them.

library.visibility.updateFailed.source: 公开状态未能更新，请刷新后重试
library.visibility.updateFailed.en: The publication state was not updated; refresh and try again.

library.visibility.choose.source: 请选择是否公开这条记录
library.visibility.choose.en: Choose whether to publish this record

library.visibility.notOwner.source: 只有提交过这条记录的浏览器才能更改公开状态
library.visibility.notOwner.en: Only a browser that submitted this record can change whether it is published

library.visibility.removedRepublish.source: 管理员已将这条记录从共享库移除，不能再次公开
library.visibility.removedRepublish.en: The operator removed this record from the shared library; it cannot be published again

library.supersededShown.source: 已显示较早代码版本的同配置记录。
library.supersededShown.en: Records with the same configuration from earlier code versions are shown.

library.supersededFolded.source: 另有{{0}}条同配置记录来自较早的代码版本，已折叠。
library.supersededFolded.en: {{0}} more records with the same configuration come from earlier code versions and are folded.

library.chooseHint.source: 点击“查看结果”打开记录详情。
library.chooseHint.en: Choose “View results” to open a record’s details.
